scripts.text:
TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_TRY_SDI_SELECT_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_TRY_SDI_SELECT_SRC
(
                Beneficiary,
                Beneficiary_Id,
                CBCGLAcctEncryted,
                CBCGLAcctSixDigits,
                Currencies,
                Direct,
                Id,
                Method,
                Pay_Receive,
                ProcessingOrg,
                Products,
                Roles,
                FILE_NAME,
				JSRC_FLG, 
				JTAR_FLG 
)


SELECT 
                Beneficiary,
                Beneficiary_Id,
                CBCGLAcctEncryted,
                CBCGLAcctSixDigits,
                Currencies,
                Direct,
                Id,
                Method,
                Pay_Receive,
                ProcessingOrg,
                Products,
                Roles,
                FILE_NAME,
				1 AS JSRC_FLG, 
				0 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_TRY_SDI]
            WHERE H = 'D';


INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_TRY_SDI_SELECT_SRC
(
                Beneficiary,
                Beneficiary_Id,
                CBCGLAcctEncryted,
                CBCGLAcctSixDigits,
                Currencies,
                Direct,
                Id,
                Method,
                Pay_Receive,
                ProcessingOrg,
                Products,
                Roles,
                FILE_NAME, 
				JSRC_FLG, 
				JTAR_FLG 
)
			SELECT 				
                CC.Beneficiary,
                CC.Beneficiary_Id,
                CC.CBCGLAcctEncryted,
                CC.CBCGLAcctSixDigits,
                CC.Currencies,
                CC.Direct,
                CC.Id,
                CC.Method,
                CC.Pay_Receive,
                CC.ProcessingOrg,
                CC.Products,
                CC.Roles,
                CC.FILE_NAME,
		        0 AS JSRC_FLG, 
				1 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM EDS.TRY_SDI CC
			WHERE CC.ISLATEST = '1';


TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_TRY_SDI_GROUP_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_TRY_SDI_GROUP_SRC
(
                Beneficiary,
                Beneficiary_Id,
                CBCGLAcctEncryted,
                CBCGLAcctSixDigits,
                Currencies,
                Direct,
                Id,
                Method,
                Pay_Receive,
                ProcessingOrg,
                Products,
                Roles,
                FILE_NAME, 
				JSRC_FLG_CNT, 
				JTAR_FLG_CNT, 
				FILE_DATE
)

select 
                Beneficiary,
                Beneficiary_Id,
                CBCGLAcctEncryted,
                CBCGLAcctSixDigits,
                Currencies,
                Direct,
                Id,
                Method,
                Pay_Receive,
                ProcessingOrg,
                Products,
                Roles,
				FILE_NAME, 
				JSRC_FLG_CNT, 
				JTAR_FLG_CNT,
				CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME , 12), 8) AS DATE) FILE_DATE
from 
(
	SELECT 				
                Beneficiary,
                Beneficiary_Id,
                CBCGLAcctEncryted,
                CBCGLAcctSixDigits,
                Currencies,
                Direct,
                Id,
                Method,
                Pay_Receive,
                ProcessingOrg,
                Products,
                Roles,
				MAX(FILE_NAME) FILE_NAME, 
				SUM(JSRC_FLG) AS JSRC_FLG_CNT, 
				SUM(JTAR_FLG) AS JTAR_FLG_CNT
	FROM d360.STG_EDS_TRY_SDI_SELECT_SRC
	GROUP BY 					
                Beneficiary,
                Beneficiary_Id,
                CBCGLAcctEncryted,
                CBCGLAcctSixDigits,
                Currencies,
                Direct,
                Id,
                Method,
                Pay_Receive,
                ProcessingOrg,
                Products,
                Roles
	HAVING ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) > 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 0 ) OR ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 1) 
) AS TEMP


DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY FROM EDS.DATE_DIM 
WHERE FULLDATE = @DATETOPROCESS;	


UPDATE A
SET
SCD_END_DATE = @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
, ISLATEST = 0
FROM EDS.TRY_SDI A 
INNER JOIN d360.STG_EDS_TRY_SDI_GROUP_SRC B ON
COALESCE(A.ID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.ID,'-1')
AND A.ISLATEST = 1
AND B.JTAR_FLG_CNT = 1


INSERT INTO EDS.TRY_SDI
(
                Beneficiary,
                Beneficiary_Id,
                CBCGLAcctEncryted,
                CBCGLAcctSixDigits,
                Currencies,
                Direct,
                Id,
                Method,
                Pay_Receive,
                ProcessingOrg,
                Products,
                Roles,
				SCD_START_DATE, 
				SCD_END_DATE, 
				ISACTIVE, 
				ISLATEST, 
				BNK_CODE, 
				SOURCE_CODE, 
				FILE_NAME, 
				insert_dttm
)
SELECT
                SRC.Beneficiary,
                SRC.Beneficiary_Id,
                SRC.CBCGLAcctEncryted,
                SRC.CBCGLAcctSixDigits,
                SRC.Currencies,
                SRC.Direct,
                SRC.Id,
                SRC.Method,
                SRC.Pay_Receive,
                SRC.ProcessingOrg,
                SRC.Products,
                SRC.Roles,
				@DATETOPROCESS,
				'9999-12-31',
				1,
				1,
				LEFT(SRC.FILE_NAME,5),
				'TRY',
				SRC.FILE_NAME,
				CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime)
FROM d360.STG_EDS_TRY_SDI_GROUP_SRC SRC
WHERE JSRC_FLG_CNT > 0
